pipeline: Hotspawn lobby (entries) -> HLTV (fixture verification) -> EGamersWorld bc.game module + Polymarket (prices) -> de-margin -> consensus line

row_fields.book_odds: decimal odds as displayed, team A / team B (bc.game via EGamersWorld)
row_fields.book_p_a/book_p_b: de-margined probability from the bookmaker line
row_fields.pm_prices: Polymarket displayed cents for team A / team B
row_fields.line_p_a/line_p_b: our line: equal-weight average of available de-margined sources
row_fields.quality: High/Medium/Low from captured spread and liquidity
row_fields.verified: true only when at least one external two-sided price was captured
